checkpoint_qualification: Matching log output paths do not authenticate which run last wrote the archived bytes. The headers lack training/model identity metadata. Neither export is classified as Mock-generated, and neither establishes availability of the complete manuscript checkpoint.

historical_author_material.reason: Historical debugging and planning material is useful for the authors' audit trail but is not a verified execution guide or proof of manuscript reproduction. Relevant limitations and implementation correspondence are disclosed in the reviewer documentation.

other_categories.reason: Repository internals and educational/reference material are not needed for the retained entry points. Supplied repository identifiers and pertinent notices are recorded separately.
Upstream examples, tests and documentation are omitted; complete non-cache runtime src trees, package resources and necessary installation metadata are retained.

Complete reference checkouts are omitted; their license texts and provenance are retained. No direct runtime import from these checkouts was found. This does not rule out implementation adaptation; ICEdit correspondence is documented in docs/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
Test/generated images and interpreter caches are excluded. No formal manuscript dataset/split or successful experiment is inferred from these assets.

limits: No model execution was needed to classify these omissions. This record does not imply that the remaining source fully implements the paper, nor that omitted weights or logs must be recreated through new experiments.
